heading.text: Why does taking antibiotics lead to antibiotic resistance?

items: Antibiotic resistance does not mean the body is becoming resistant to antibiotics; it is that bacteria have become resistant to the antibiotics designed to kill them.
When bacteria become resistant, antibiotics cannot fight them, and the bacteria multiply.
Some resistant bacteria can be harder to treat and can spread to other people.
